exposure: standardized use of iPads for delivering new parent education
outcome: parents' compliance rates with viewing an educational video about Abusive Head Trauma (AHT)
cohort: Parents in the mother-baby unit across 6 campuses of a large South Carolina health care system.
finding: The implementation of a standardized iPad-based protocol significantly improved the percentage of new parents who viewed an educational video about Abusive Head Trauma (AHT) in the mother-baby unit.
cross-section timing: during hospitalization, pre- and post-iPad implementation
